item.description:
Thimble 0.8.0 keeps pictures with a project, answers Claude's questions, and shows a repo's docs beside its roadmap.
- Pictures: drop, paste, or share an image into a project as Inspiration, To Fix, or Reference, with a caption. Click one to see it large, use the arrow keys to go through them, and press Space for Quick Look. - Make Task on a To Fix picture adds a task linked to it, and the picture shows with the task. Quick Capture and the Share menu take images too, with a project picker. - Pictures sync to your other devices through your folder or bucket, sealed like everything else. Each image is fetched when it's shown, and a project holds up to 100 MB of them. - Questions: when Claude needs you to decide something, it asks in the project, with options and a recommendation. Answer there, and a task it held up stops waiting. - From the Repo: a project whose card points at a folder on this Mac shows that repo's README and docs on its Docs page, read-only. Allow the folder once in Settings > Privacy. - `thimble pictures` and `thimble questions` work from the command line and the MCP server. Android: notes read like a page, and moving sync to a bucket brings pictures along.
